calculationEvidence.title: Saved formula calculation evidence
calculationEvidence.measurementTitle: Saved formula calculation history for this measurement
calculationEvidence.rangeTitle: Range measurements and formulas actually used
calculationEvidence.notice: Only saved evidence is read; no recalculation occurs. The calculation judgment at the time may differ from the current chart. Check specifications and precision. Specifications are snapshots at calculation time; independent specification version numbers and control limit versions at the time were not recorded.
calculationEvidence.aggregate: This point aggregates multiple measurements without all member identifiers. A single formula version cannot be confirmed for the subgroup. Inspect individual measurements through date segments; the first measurement does not represent the whole subgroup.
calculationEvidence.noId: This point is a derived statistic or has no measurement identifier, so a formula for one measurement cannot be identified. Inspect individual measurements through date segments.
calculationEvidence.notApplicable: Not chemical data; analysis formula traceability is not applicable.
calculationEvidence.rangeCount: All measurements in this PPC date range: {total} (not limited by the chart batch filter); measurements without saved version links: {unknown}.
calculationEvidence.multiple: Multiple formula versions were saved in this range. Check each measurement; do not treat them as a single formula.
calculationEvidence.empty: No measurements in this range. No formula is inferred.
calculationEvidence.unknown: Cannot confirm the version at the time (old measurement without saved traceability).
calculationEvidence.incomplete: Calculation evidence is incomplete and cannot be confirmed. The current formula is not substituted.
calculationEvidence.results: Raw calculation result: {raw}; stored result: {stored}; specification judgment at calculation time: {judgment}
calculationEvidence.specification: Specification snapshot at calculation time: segment {segment}; LSL {lsl} / USL {usl} / target {target}

chartSummary.title: SPC control item overview
chartSummary.empty: No calculable measurements for these conditions

chartSummary.twoSided: Two-sided specifications: Cpk = min((USL − mean) / (3 × σwithin), (mean − LSL) / (3 × σwithin)); Ppk uses σoverall.
chartSummary.upperOnly: USL only: Cpk = (USL − mean) / (3 × σwithin); Ppk = (USL − mean) / (3 × σoverall).
chartSummary.lowerOnly: LSL only: Cpk = (mean − LSL) / (3 × σwithin); Ppk = (mean − LSL) / (3 × σoverall).
chartSummary.sigmaNotice: σwithin is short-term within-subgroup variation; σoverall is overall long-term variation across report measurements.
chartSummary.ppkNotice: The report column is labeled Cpk but displays the backend Ppk value, representing overall capability for the entire period.

calibration.emailHelp: Daily reminders are sent to the email recipients configured for each instrument.
calibration.chatHelp: Daily reminders go to the Chat group specified by this Webhook. Each instrument receives one message per reminder stage.
calibration.webhookStored: Webhook saved. Test it directly or paste a new URL to replace it.
calibration.webhookHow: How do I get a Webhook URL?
calibration.webhookInstructions: In Synology Chat, select your avatar → Integration → Incoming Webhooks. Create one, select the recipient group, and paste the complete URL above.
calibration.emailTestHelp: Only sends to the address below, with a test subject. It does not record a due-date reminder or enable daily email delivery.
calibration.chatTestHelp: Immediately sends a test message to the selected group without enabling the daily schedule. Save settings to retain a new URL.
calibration.importHelp: Upload → Preview → Select instruments → Complete master data → Confirm import. Only the first worksheet is read; existing codes are skipped.
calibration.importFileLabel: Instrument calibration list (.xlsx, up to 10 MB)
calibration.formulaHelp: Formula dates use Excel's saved results. Recalculate and save before upload. Correct unknown intervals, uncalibrated dates and planned dates in a copy first. Import does not certify a successful calibration.
calibration.applySelected: Apply to selected instruments (import different departments separately)
calibration.noOperators: No active personnel available. Check personnel data or reload the page.
calibration.includeCustodian: Include the custodian under existing notification rules (no email is sent during import)
calibration.confirmDataHelp: I have checked the selected instruments' dates, warnings and master data above.
calibration.importAgainHelp: To import again, first select Parse / preview again.
calibration.certificateTooLarge: The file must not exceed 10 MB.
calibration.webhookMissing: Paste a Synology Chat Webhook URL first.
calibration.emailMissing: Enter a test recipient email first.
calibration.chatFailed: Chat delivery failed. Check the group settings.
calibration.importFileInvalid: Select an .xlsx file no larger than 10 MB.
calibration.testSent: Test notification sent to {recipient} (instrument {code}). This email is not recorded as a daily reminder.
calibration.calculated: Automatically calculated using the {months}-month calibration interval.
calibration.reminderPending: Add the custom number of days first, or clear the input.
calibration.webhookKeep: Configured; leave blank to keep the existing URL

settings.smtpTitle: SMTP server and quality alert settings
settings.smtpDescription: Configure automatic email delivery for SPC out-of-control (OOC) and out-of-specification (OOS) alerts, including local backup paths.
settings.portHelp: 💡 A port ending in 's' (such as 110s) automatically enables SSL encryption
settings.recipientFallback: recipients; the default recipient email is used if none are selected.
settings.noActiveEmails: No active users have an email address configured.
settings.credentials: Authentication credentials (leave blank if not required)
settings.archive: Local email archive and audit copies
settings.saveLocal: Save an HTML copy of sent emails in a local server folder
settings.outboxHelp: The system saves .html email copies here. Open them to review the layout even without an external SMTP connection.
settings.testConnectionHelp: Send a formatted notification email to check the firewall, host address and authentication credentials.
settings.testAlert: Simulate a real-time OOS quality alert email
settings.testConnectionFailed: External SMTP connection could not be established
settings.hostFailedSuffix: ) refused the connection or did not respond. The server may be stopped or blocked by a firewall, so external delivery could not be completed.
settings.localCopyHelp: The email content was also saved as a webpage. Open the path below to review it even without external SMTP access:
settings.rulesTitle: 💡 Automatic notifications and Western Electric rules
settings.rulesHelp: When measurements are uploaded or imported, the SPC engine calculates in the background. If a Western Electric rule is triggered or a value exceeds USL / LSL, the system uses these SMTP settings to send a quality alert.
settings.reportDescription: Choose recipients for the weekly and monthly SPC control item overview. The system exports Excel and sends it at the scheduled time.
settings.checkedSuffix: recipients. Only users with email addresses are listed.
settings.noDepartmentEmails: No users in this department have an email address
settings.operatorsDescription: Manage measurement personnel, employee IDs, departments and notification email addresses
settings.operatorsGuideDescription: Configure measurement personnel. SPC alerts are sent to the email addresses configured here.
settings.searchPeopleHelp: Search by employee ID, name, department or email.
settings.addPeopleHelp: Select Add operator and enter the employee ID, name, department, job title and email.
settings.notificationsHelp: Check email addresses so alerts and resolution reminders can be delivered.
settings.maintainStatusHelp: Deactivate personnel who have left or no longer need notifications. Historical data remains available.
settings.comparisonSuffix: people. Master data and permissions are unchanged.
settings.operatorSearch: Search employee IDs, names, departments or emails...
settings.permissionHelp: This controls page visibility only. Editing, imports and administrative actions remain protected by Viewer / Editor roles.
settings.recipientMissing: Select at least one recipient with an email address.
settings.reportSaved: SPC weekly / monthly report delivery settings saved.
settings.operatorRequired: Employee ID and name are required.
settings.passwordKeep: Configured; leave blank to keep the existing password
settings.sendNowFallback: Report immediate delivery complete: {success} succeeded, {failed} failed.
settings.confirmSync: Sync {count} selected personnel? Existing SPC permissions and status will be retained.

trace.queryDescription: Filter by work order, lot, serial number or time range. Find measurement batches and open the SPC control chart to review CPK and control results.
trace.queryGuide: Module guide: quality history and SPC query
trace.queryGuideDescription: Search quality history by work order, lot or serial number. Open a batch's SPC chart or export the plant CPK overview.
trace.criteriaHelp: Enter a work order, Lot No or SN. Use each criterion alone or combine them.
trace.executeHelp: The query lists matching measurement batches and related alerts.
trace.viewChartHelp: Select the SPC chart action in the results to open the batch's control chart.
trace.exportHelp: Select a month and export the plant CPK overview for that month.
trace.genealogyGuideDescription: Search upstream and downstream production relationships by lot or work order. The tree shows parent, target and child lots.
trace.chooseSearchHelp: Switch between lot and work-order searches.
trace.treeQueryHelp: Enter a LotNo or WorkOrderNo, then query the genealogy.
trace.viewNodesHelp: Select a lot node to view routing history and quality events in the side panel.
trace.traceRelationsHelp: Select another node to recenter the tree on its parent, child and related lots.
trace.treeEmpty: Enter a lot or work order to draw its genealogy
trace.etchDescription: Data comes from PmrPortal etch reports. Front and back use complete sets of 25 / 50 points for X̄-S; overall etch rate and actual line speed use I-MR. Legacy single-value summaries remain in historical queries.
trace.noMapping: No active PPC exists for this line. Check the SPC control item settings.
trace.missingPpc: This batch has no SPC control item ppcId, so its control chart cannot be opened automatically.
trace.searchFailed: No data found or an error occurred
